question.instructions: Does the cited evidence support the claim?

criteria.true: Yes. The claim follows directly from the cited evidence without requiring additional assumptions, business knowledge, or unstated rules.
criteria.false: No. The claim is contradicted by the evidence or requires assumptions, external knowledge, or unstated rules that are not present in the cited evidence.

measurement.rule: A case is a gate when it is right by at least one logit taken as the minimum over every arm (signed margin = logit when expected is true, minus logit when false), and the gate holds at least one case of each label. A known failure is wrong on every arm. Every other case is a watch case.
measurement.logit_definition: ln(p/(1-p)) of the answer's noul, to three decimals; the logits are bf16, so they move in steps of 0.125.

cases.name: Direct field read
cases.state:
Claim: The account plan has 4 high-value potentials.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1001, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: high_value_potentials_count = 4, potentials_count = 11, linked_opportunities_count = 0.
cases.note: The claim restates a field. No inference. Corrected: the claim said "whitespace potentials", and no field names whitespace, so under these criteria the qualifier is unsupported (the stock model answered NO, 0.22).

cases.name: Direct contradiction
cases.state:
Claim: The account plan has 4 high-value potentials.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1001, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: high_value_potentials_count = 0, potentials_count = 11, linked_opportunities_count = 11.
cases.note: Inversion of case 1. Same claim, field contradicts it. Corrected with case 1, so the inversion pair stays one claim against opposite evidence.

cases.name: Threshold comparison
cases.state:
Claim: The scorecard has not been updated in more than three months.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1002, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: days_since_scorecard_update = 118, days_since_whitespace_update = 41, days_since_map_update = 63.
cases.note: 118 > ~90. Arithmetic on a present field, nothing external.

cases.name: Threshold comparison contradicted
cases.state:
Claim: The scorecard has not been updated in more than three months.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1002, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: days_since_scorecard_update = 12, days_since_whitespace_update = 41, days_since_map_update = 63.

cases.name: Right source, wrong subject
cases.state:
Claim: The renewal is at risk because the economic buyer changed in Q3.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1003, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: days_since_scorecard_update = 12, tasks_open_count = 3, tasks_in_progress_count = 1.
cases.note: The citation is real, correctly formed and resolves. It simply says nothing about buyers or renewals. This is the case a reference-existence check cannot catch.

cases.name: Business judgement
cases.state:
Claim: Stakeholder coverage on this account is weak.

Cited evidence: stakeholder_map, account_name = 'Northwind Logistics', retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: 3 contacts mapped, 1 flagged as champion, no economic buyer identified, stakeholder_map_last_modified_date = 2026-03-04.
cases.note: "Weak" requires a threshold that exists nowhere in the evidence. The evidence is consistent with the claim but does not entail it.

cases.name: Wrong field, matching number
cases.state:
Claim: There are 12 open tasks on this account plan.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1004, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: tasks_total_count = 12, tasks_open_count = 5, tasks_in_progress_count = 3.
cases.note: The number 12 is present, attached to a different field. Tests whether the model reads the field or pattern-matches the digit.

cases.name: Scope creep
cases.state:
Claim: No initiative on this account has any linked opportunity.

Cited evidence: whitespace_opportunity, initiative_name = 'Platform Modernisation', retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: linked_opportunities_count = 0.
cases.note: Evidence covers one initiative. The claim quantifies over all of them.

cases.name: Null is not false
cases.state:
Claim: The executive sponsor is not engaged on this account.

Cited evidence: stakeholder_map, account_name = 'Fabrikam Energy', retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: champion_identified = true, exec_sponsor_engaged = null.
cases.note: Null means unrecorded, not negative. A system that treats absent as false will publish this claim.

cases.name: Two-field comparison
cases.state:
Claim: There are more open tasks than tasks in progress.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1005, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: tasks_total_count = 14, tasks_open_count = 7, tasks_in_progress_count = 2.

cases.name: Supported observation, unsupported cause
cases.state:
Claim: The plan is stale because the account owner changed.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1006, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: days_since_scorecard_update = 140, days_since_whitespace_update = 152, days_since_map_update = 160.
cases.note: Staleness is entailed. The causal attribution is not — nothing in the evidence mentions ownership. A claim that is half-supported must still fail.

cases.name: Absence from an enumerated list
cases.state:
Claim: No economic buyer has been identified on the account map.

Cited evidence: stakeholder_map, account_name = 'Contoso Retail', retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: node count = 3, node roles (all nodes) = [Champion, Technical Evaluator, End User].
cases.note: Contrast with case 9. Here the list is complete and enumerated, so absence is informative. There the field was explicitly null. Corrected: the contributed text said `node roles present`, which does not state that the list is complete (only the node count implies it). On the abliterated artifact p(yes) was 0.32 as contributed, 0.56 corrected; stock, 0.71 corrected.

cases.name: Date arithmetic
cases.state:
Claim: The renewal is less than 90 days away.

Cited evidence: plan_header, plan_id=PLAN-1007, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: as_of_date = 2026-09-20, renewal_date = 2026-11-15, plan_status = Active.
cases.note: 56 days. Both dates present in the evidence. Corrected: "days away" needs a today, and `retrieved` is the extraction date, so `as_of_date` states it. Still answered NO (stock 0.35 corrected; the abliterated artifact 0.15 corrected, 0.03 as contributed): the model does not do this date arithmetic under these criteria. A known failure, not a relabel.

cases.name: Date arithmetic contradicted
cases.state:
Claim: The renewal is less than 90 days away.

Cited evidence: plan_header, plan_id=PLAN-1007, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: as_of_date = 2026-09-20, renewal_date = 2027-06-30, plan_status = Active.
cases.note: Inversion of case 13. ~283 days. Corrected with case 13, so the inversion pair stays one claim against opposite evidence.

cases.name: Unstated standard
cases.state:
Claim: This account plan does not meet the minimum completeness standard.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1008, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: scorecard_questions_answered = 14, scorecard_questions_total = 22.
cases.note: There is no standard in the evidence. The claim imports a rule from outside it.

cases.name: Date restatement
cases.state:
Claim: The account map has not been modified since March 2026.

Cited evidence: stakeholder_map, account_name = 'Litware Manufacturing', retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: stakeholder_map_last_modified_date = 2026-03-04, node count = 6.

cases.name: Proportion
cases.state:
Claim: Fewer than half of the potentials are high-value.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1009, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: high_value_potentials_count = 4, potentials_count = 11.
cases.note: 4 < 5.5. Both operands present. Corrected: the claim said "whitespace potentials", and no field names whitespace, so under these criteria the qualifier is unsupported (the stock model answered NO, 0.18).

cases.name: Zero-valued field
cases.state:
Claim: No task on this plan is currently in progress.

Cited evidence: plan_health, plan_id=PLAN-1010, retrieved 2026-09-20.
Fields: tasks_total_count = 9, tasks_open_count = 9, tasks_in_progress_count = 0.
cases.note: Explicit zero, not a null. Contrast with case 9.
